_meta.description: Frozen grounding gold for the fixed snapshot corpus. Produced ONCE by eval/build_gold.py from the engine's own tool registry; every numeric answer the assistant gives is scored against these values. Do not regenerate silently: a rebuild must be reviewed like any golden-file change (see measures_v2.json discipline). Tool outputs are frozen verbatim as provenance.
